environment.description: Rails 7.1 application on AWS ECS Fargate with Amazon RDS PostgreSQL 15.4. Database access uses IAM authentication with a custom PostgreSQL role `app_readonly` created via: CREATE ROLE app_readonly WITH LOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOBYPASSRLS; The RDS parameter group has `rds.force_ssl = 1`. Row Level Security is enforced with FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on all tenant-scoped tables. Additionally, an RDS Proxy sits between the application and database with connection pinning disabled and IAM auth required. The PostgreSQL role explicitly has NOBYPASSRLS, meaning RLS policies are enforced regardless of table ownership. A pg_audit extension logs all queries with the session variable context. The VPC security group restricts DB access to only the ECS task security group on port 5432.
